authority: owner ruling 2026-08-21 — archive to inaccessible evidence custody
grants_nothing: the policy contains only Deny. It grants no access and removes none from any other prefix: absent an explicit Deny, evaluation falls through to identity policies exactly as before.
honest_scope: custody, audit and administrative principals RETAIN access by design. An unconditional Deny would block the evidence verification this archive exists to support. This is a scoped control, not a claim that nobody can read the object.
why_resource_side: the evaluator host role grants no read on this bucket, so today it has no route by OMISSION. Omission is not a control — it holds only until someone attaches a policy. The 2026-08-21 pre-read failure was the mirror image: a complete and correct identity-side amendment defeated by the resource side nobody had re-pointed.
